units.source_text: 此时但闻邻室足音顿顿，传来说话的声音：

en.t: Just then, footsteps sounded from the neighboring room, and voices could be heard speaking:

units.source_text: “外婆，前些日子到寺里来的那个源氏公子来了！

en.t: Grandmother, that Lord Genji who came to the temple the other day is here!
Why do you not go and see him?

units.source_text: 众侍女困窘了，连忙阻止她：“静些儿！”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting were embarrassed and hurried to stop her, saying, Be quiet!

units.source_text: 外婆说过的：‘见了源氏公子，病就好起来了。’

en.t: Grandmother said, If I see Lord Genji, my illness will get better.
That is why I told her!

units.source_text: 她这样说，自以为学会了一句聪明话。

en.t: Saying this, she thought she had learned a clever phrase.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了觉得很有意思，但恐众侍女无以为颜，只装作没听见。

en.t: Lord Genji found it amusing when he heard it, but fearing the ladies-in-waiting would lose face, he merely pretended not to have heard.

units.source_text: 他郑重地说了一番问候的话，即便告辞。

en.t: He offered a formal greeting of concern, then immediately took his leave.

units.source_text: 心中想道：“果然还是一个全不懂事的孩子。

en.t: In his heart he thought, As expected, she is still a child who understands nothing at all.

units.source_text: 但以后可以好好地教养起来。”

en.t: But in time she can be carefully brought up and taught.
